description: Implementation of the WifiManagerState class for managing WiFi states, including retrieving current WiFi state, connected SSID, and supported security modes, as well as enabling/disabling WiFi interfaces.

classes.name: WifiManagerState
classes.description: Manages WiFi state, caches current state, and interfaces with underlying system calls to control WiFi hardware.

methods.name: to_wifi_state
methods.description: Converts WiFi status code to enum WifiState.

methods.name: setWifiStateCache
methods.description: Sets the WiFi state cache variables.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state, using cache if enabled.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Fetches details about the currently connected SSID, BSSID, and related metrics.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the WiFi interface based on input parameters.

methods.name: getSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Provides a list of supported WiFi security modes.
